record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: For the local normalized period integral I_v attached to Π_v and the Weil representation ω_{V_v,ψ_v,μ_v}, determine whether I_v is nonzero exactly when the local branching space Hom_{U(V)(F_v)}(Π_v, ω_{V_v,ψ_v,μ_v}) is nonzero, and compute this local integral at almost all places v of F where all data are unramified.

evidence.quote: Now one would like to: • show that Iv is nonzero if and only if HomU(V )(Fv)(Πv, ωVv,ψv,µv) 6= 0; • compute this integral at almost all places v of F where every data involved is unramified.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F$ be a number field with a quadratic extension $E/F$, and let $\mathbb{A}=\mathbb{A}_F$ denote its ring of adeles. Fix a nontrivial additive character $\psi:F\backslash\mathbb{A}\to\mathbb{C}^\times$ and a Hecke character $\mu$ of $E^\times\backslash\mathbb{A}_E^\times$ whose restriction to $\mathbb{A}_F^\times$ is the quadratic character associated with $E/F$. Let $V$ be a Hermitian space over $E$ of dimension $n$, with unitary group $U(V)$, and let $\omega_{V,\psi,\mu}=\otimes_v \omega_{V_v,\psi_v,\mu_v}$ denote the associated global Weil representation of $U(V)(\mathbb{A})$.

Let $\Pi=\otimes_v \Pi_v$ be a cuspidal automorphic representation of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{A}_E)$ that is conjugate self-dual with the appropriate sign so that the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad period integral
$$\mathcal{P}(\varphi,\phi)=\int_{U(V)(F)\backslash U(V)(\mathbb{A})}\varphi(h)\,\overline{\theta_{\psi,\mu}(\phi)(h)}\,dh$$
is defined for $\varphi$ in the space of $\Pi$ (suitably restricted) and $\phi$ in $\omega_{V,\psi,\mu}$. Suppose $\mathcal{P}$ factorizes as a product of local normalized period integrals $I_v:\Pi_v\otimes\omega_{V_v,\psi_v,\mu_v}\to\mathbb{C}$, one at each place $v$ of $F$.

(a) Prove that $I_v\not\equiv 0$ if and only if $\mathrm{Hom}_{U(V)(F_v)}\!\bigl(\Pi_v,\omega_{V_v,\psi_v,\mu_v}\bigr)\neq 0$.

(b) For almost all places $v$ of $F$ where $E/F$, $\psi_v$, $\mu_v$, $V_v$, and $\Pi_v$ are all unramified, evaluate $I_v$ explicitly on unramified data in terms of local $L$-factors.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2023–2025) on the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for unitary groups has established the unramified local period computation and the equivalence with local branching nonvanishing in several cases, notably under unramifiedness assumptions on the quadratic extension and the representations (e.g., "Twisted GGP conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions"). The general case—covering all places and arbitrary ramification—is not yet fully resolved, but substantial partial results exist.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions
status_evidence.snippet: The twisted global Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for U(V)⊂GL(V) has been proved under unramifiedness assumptions and local conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Twisted GGP is proved under unramifiedness assumptions, indicating partial resolution including the unramified local integral computation.

status_evidence.title: Central values of Asai L-functions and twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Relative trace formula approach with unramified test function matching, building on unramified period computations.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress via relative trace formula on the twisted GGP local/global problems.
